clue.text: The woman should be given a hand when working

definitions.text: The woman should be given a hand when working

parts.words: The woman should be given a hand when working
parts.note: reads like a call to applaud a hard-working woman, but describes a professional whose job is tending clients' hands and nails

explanation.surface: A plea to applaud a woman while she is on the job.
explanation.definitionFit: A beautician who files and polishes nails takes each customer's hand as she works.

clue.text: Article on guys is the last word!

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
men are guys

explanation.surface: An article about men has the final say.
explanation.definitionFit: Said at the close of a prayer, it is literally the final utterance.

clue.text: Private doctor filling in this month?

indicators.note: filling means the doctor goes inside the other piece

parts.note: inst., instant, means of this month in old business letters
MO is a medical officer

explanation.surface: A private doctor standing in during this month.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inst.' (instant) is an old business-letter abbreviation for this month.
explanation.definitionFit: Innermost, most personal and secret.

clue.text: Representation of nude man (anonymous)

indicators.note: a representation is a rendering, so the letters of nude man are reworked

explanation.surface: A painting of an unidentified naked man.
explanation.definitionFit: Without a name given, nameless.

clue.text: The first person to back up a Greek character

parts.note: I is the first person pronoun

indicators.note: in a down clue, back up means the word to is written upwards

explanation.surface: The first man to support a Greek figure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back up' reverses TO to OT, since the clue is written downwards.
explanation.definitionFit: The ninth letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Blunder into someone fastening up a dog

indicators.note: into means the blunder goes inside the other piece

parts.note: a tier is one who ties
to err is to blunder

explanation.surface: Stumbling into someone who is tying up a dog.
explanation.definitionFit: A small breed of dog originally used for hunting burrowing animals.

clue.text: Bring down the rate

parts.note: sounds like cutting a financial rate, but means reducing speed

explanation.surface: Lower the interest rate.
explanation.definitionFit: To slow down, reducing velocity.

clue.text: Youngster's grant is in a foreign currency

definitions.note: the 's stands for is, so the definition is the youngster

indicators.note: in places the grant piece inside the other

parts.note: a cent is a coin of many foreign currencies
doles are handouts or grants, and grant is gives grant's

explanation.surface: A youngster's allowance is paid in a foreign currency.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grant is' is read as the possessive grant's, giving a plural handout; the 's of 'Youngster's' is just 'is', linking the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A teenager, someone growing up.

clue.text: Freshly-made drink

indicators.note: freshly suggests something newly remade, so the letters of made are put together anew

explanation.surface: Something newly prepared to drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Honey wine, an old fermented beverage.

clue.text: He finishes having taken time in turning over duty-list

parts.note: a term is a period of time
taken as written

indicators.note: turning over signals that the duty-list word is read backwards

parts.note: a rota is a duty list

explanation.surface: Someone who has served his time ends up reorganising the staff rota.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning over' reverses ROTA to ATOR. 'time' is TERM, not the usual T.
explanation.definitionFit: One who brings things to an end, an ender or closer.

clue.text: Divulge hesitation about meat

indicators.note: about signals turning the hesitation word round

parts.note: er is the sound of hesitating
veal is calf meat

explanation.surface: Hesitating over some meat before telling a secret.
explanation.definitionFit: To disclose or make known.

clue.text: Stayed and paid

explanation.surface: Someone stayed on and paid the bill.
explanation.definitionFit: Settled means remained in a place (stayed) and also cleared an account (paid).

clue.text: Making little mark, so opting out

explanation.surface: Leaving a faint mark and withdrawing from the contest.
explanation.definitionFit: Scratching is marking a surface lightly, and withdrawing a horse or competitor from a race.

clue.text: Soldiers giving their names wrongly

indicators.note: wrongly tells us the letters of their names are set out incorrectly

explanation.surface: Troops giving false names.
explanation.definitionFit: A corps of seaborne infantry.

clue.text: Many left town

parts.note: D is 500 in Roman numerals, so many
over means left over, remaining

explanation.surface: Lots of people departed from the town.
explanation.walkthrough: DOVER is a port town in Kent, England.
explanation.definitionFit: A port on the Kent coast of England, a place name.

clue.text: Stabilisers found on an ocean-going vessel

definitions.text: Stabilisers found on an ocean-going vessel

parts.words: Stabilisers found on an ocean-going vessel
parts.note: suggests a ship's mechanical stabilisers, but means the steadiness a sailor's limbs acquire at sea

explanation.surface: Devices fitted to a liner to stop it rolling.
explanation.definitionFit: The ability of seasoned sailors to keep their balance on a pitching deck.

clue.text: Report it's safe

explanation.surface: A statement that all is secure.
explanation.definitionFit: Sound is a noise like a report (a bang) and also means secure, unharmed.

clue.text: College authority or benefactor

parts.note: a don is a university college teacher
taken as written

explanation.surface: A college figure, or someone who funds it.
explanation.definitionFit: A giver of money or gifts.

clue.text: Much regrets the ways of the French

explanation.surface: Someone deeply sorry about French streets.
explanation.definitionFit: Rues means is sorry for (regrets much), and rues are French streets or ways.

clue.text: The right one will show dash

parts.note: an ace is the one in cards

explanation.surface: The correct person will display flair.
explanation.definitionFit: A dash is a sprint, a short fast run.

clue.text: Female with an over bright colouring

parts.note: a hen is a female bird

indicators.note: over signals that the word an is turned round

explanation.surface: A woman with an overly bright hair colour.
explanation.definitionFit: A reddish dye used on hair and skin.

clue.text: A deep creature's engagement token

parts.note: split as a female's engagement band, it names a fish of the sea

explanation.surface: A sea creature's engagement gift.
explanation.definitionFit: A silvery food fish of the ocean, punned as a woman's wedding band.

clue.text: A pound in rises negotiated — or close

indicators.note: negotiated means worked out, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A pound rises in negotiation, or it is near.
explanation.walkthrough: 'negotiated' rearranges L and RISES into IRLESS. 'close' means stuffy, not near.
explanation.definitionFit: Close weather is stuffy, without fresh air.

clue.text: This kitchen gadget rotates for mixing

indicators.note: for mixing tells us the letters of rotates are jumbled

explanation.surface: A kitchen appliance that spins round to blend food.
explanation.definitionFit: A device for browning bread slices.

clue.text: Small daughter is told to go, making protest

parts.note: D is the small, abbreviated form of daughter
taken as written
sent means dispatched, told to go

explanation.surface: A young daughter is sent away and complains.
explanation.definitionFit: Disagreement or objection to an official view.

clue.text: Skinhead, alert maybe but not so fresh

parts.note: the head, or first letter, of skin is S

indicators.note: maybe suggests a possible rearrangement of alert

explanation.surface: An alert skinhead who is past his best.
explanation.definitionFit: Staler means older and less fresh, of bread.

clue.text: A man, if preceding the Queen, must be neat

parts.note: he is a pronoun for a man
taken as written
ER is the royal cipher, Elizabeth Regina

explanation.surface: A man who comes before the Queen must be tidy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'neat' is an old word for cattle, not tidy.
explanation.definitionFit: Neat is an archaic term for cattle, and a young cow is one of them.

clue.text: A person giving voice in sepulchral tones

indicators.note: in means the answer sits inside the words sepulchral tones

explanation.surface: Someone singing in a deep, mournful voice.
explanation.definitionFit: A singer with a low female or high male voice.

clue.text: Set against a diligent worker put over one

indicators.note: in a down clue, put over places the worker above the one

parts.note: an ant is the proverbial diligent worker
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A hard worker placed ahead of someone else.
explanation.definitionFit: Opposed to something, contrary.

clue.text: Malaise causing some resentment

explanation.surface: Feeling unwell and a touch bitter.
explanation.definitionFit: Ill feeling is literally feeling unwell (malaise) and also hostility or resentment.

clue.text: A point the editor made of necessity

parts.note: NE, northeast, is a compass point
ED is short for editor

explanation.surface: An editor made a point out of necessity.
explanation.definitionFit: A want or requirement.

clue.text: Transport for friendly force

parts.note: good means kind or friendly
strain means force or pressure

explanation.surface: Vehicles for a peacekeeping army.
explanation.definitionFit: A railway freight vehicle carries cargo.
